subject: prd/config-driven-portability
statement: When it loads a configuration, the engine shall reject a cross-field-inconsistent configuration — a path escaping the repository root, a reference to an absent surface — with a named error and no partial application.
rationale: config coherence folds into the one job (D-2); extends the closed-schema contract (INV-32)
fit_criterion: each malformed-config fixture is refused by name; no partial write or resolution occurs
